info.comment: Flat vector meal-slot icon for morning AM Desk. A navy office desk with a rising sun disk in a blue square window, a white mug, and a small oat bowl. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, white, light gray #E6EBF2. No text, no letters, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges.
